message:
In the twin under-deck Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) retrofit concept, the tuning approach has 1.81 hertz versus 1.86 hertz inconsistency. To check it I used whiteboard cross-check of the Den Hartog optimum result (E3). I found 1.81 hertz at 5.0 percent mass ratio differing by 0.05 hertz from inspiration, according to Den Hartog, 1934. I propose Structural Dynamics Lead please reconcile mass ratio and optimum formula. My position: not ready because tuning basis is unresolved.

In the concealed twin-unit support concept, the U-bolt preload and slip method has missing quantification. To check it I used process review of the unit weight calculation (E10) with the slip objection (O2). I found 2452.5 newtons per unit with no slip margin in newtons, according to Coulomb, 1785. I propose Retrofit Integration Architect please compute preload and slip factor with clearance. My position: not ready because support safety remains open.

In the crowd comfort verification concept, the acceptance method has target drift from Comfort Level (CL, Setra comfort grade) CL1 to CL2. To check it I used target comparison of the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (E6) against the comfort target assumption (C1). I found 0.74 metres per second squared exceeding 0.5 metres per second squared limit, according to Setra, 2006. I propose Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner please confirm CL2 acceptance with Vibration Control Specialist. My position: not ready because vote came too early.
Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: tuning reconciliation requested.
Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: slip margin computation requested.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner: target agreement requested.
Note on Vibration Control Specialist: detuning confirmation still needed.
